was in focus on Thursday as Truist upped its price target on the cybersecurity firm to $27 from $23 following a meeting with company management.

"We come away from hosting SAIL management with greater conviction in the story, as discussions consistently reinforced confidence in demand visibility, migration execution, and the emerging AI opportunity," analyst Junaid Siddiqui wrote in a note to clients. "Net/net, the meetings strengthened our conviction that SailPoint is well positioned to benefit from both a large remaining migration opportunity and the growing need to govern AI agents, machine identities, and non-human access, supporting a durable growth outlook and attractive risk-reward."
Siddiqui reiterated his Buy rating on SailPoint.

title: SailPoint in focus as Truist ups price target
